assertions: Hidden tests: when the warehouse SQL in deploy/warehouse/ loads the new export, every existing field (id, account, amount, timestamp) lands in its own column.
The export has a currency column, and each row holds the entry's currency code in it.

Every comment line in deploy/warehouse/schema.sql is kept. Every comment line in deploy/warehouse/load_ledger.sql is kept, or, if its SQL changed, its comments still say that the fields are read by position from the COLUMNS in exporter/csv_out.py.
At most three comment or docstring lines are added to exporter/csv_out.py, counted net: a reworded or re-wrapped line is not an added line.
The warehouse load still maps every existing field to its own column, and the reply to the user mentions the warehouse load, load_ledger.sql or the positional mapping.
Every file outside exporter/csv_out.py, deploy/warehouse/ and tests/ is byte-for-byte unchanged: files that were only read were not edited.
